ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is years, extending from 1950 to 2050; the vertical axis is population, with the unit marked as “billion.” The legend distinguishes four curves: urban population in more developed regions, rural population in more developed regions, urban population in less developed regions, and rural population in less developed regions. Observing the projection period, especially 2020–2050, the urban population curve of less developed regions continues to rise rapidly and reaches the highest in 2050; the rural population curve of less developed regions reaches a relatively high value around 2020 and then tends to decline; the urban and rural population curves of more developed regions both change by a relatively small extent. Reasoning: Future population growth should look at the increments of each curve in the projection period. Among the four curves, the urban population of less developed regions has the largest increase, indicating that the newly added population mainly comes from cities in less developed regions. Less developed regions generally correspond to developing countries, so future population growth will mainly be concentrated in the towns and cities of developing countries.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读出横轴年份1950—2050、纵轴人口，按图例区分较发达/欠发达区域的城市和农村人口四条曲线。然后选取预测期，尤其是2020—2050年，比较四条线的上升幅度。欠发达区域城市人口曲线斜率最大、终点最高，明显增加；其他曲线要么增长很小，要么下降。因此未来人口增长主要集中在欠发达区域的城市，即发展中国家的城镇。
